jwt_folder_path.description: Allows to override the default file system folder where the JWT token is stored. Relevant if `reuse_jwt` is set to true.

reuse_jwt.description: Terraform provider generates a JWT token on each run. For frequent terraform runs, this option allows token storage in the file system and reusing it if valid. The usage of this option should be carefully considered as it may lead to token leak. Defaults to `false`.

service_account.description: Service account ID with administrative privileges. Can be specified with the `SATORI_SA` environment variable.

expire_on.description: Expire the rule on the given date and time. RFC3339 date format is expected. Time must be in UTC (i.e. YYYY-MM-DD***T***HH:MM:SS***Z***). Empty value = never expire.

parent_data_policy.description: Parent data policy ID, the data_policy_id field of a dataset.
